SMART TOOL: Complete multi-platform project tracking in ONE call with OPTIONAL milestone-based structure. Creates Synergy session with either flat structure (next_steps checklist) OR milestone-based structure (phases with tasks/subtasks). Use this for ANY multi-step project involving 3+ tools/platforms. PRIMARY tool for complex work - use instead of calling multiple individual functions.

NEW FEATURE: Milestone Support - Set use_milestones=true and provide initial_milestones array to create structured multi-phase projects in ONE call. Each milestone can have tasks with subtasks, priorities, dependencies, documents, and time estimates.

When to use milestones vs flat:
- Use milestones: Multi-phase projects (3+ major phases), need dependencies between phases, want phase-specific documents
- Use flat: Simple linear workflows, quick tasks, single-phase projects

CRITICAL: After creating EACH resource, you MUST call synergy_get_session() first, then synergy_update_session() (flat) or synergy_update_milestone() (milestone-based) to add document URLs. See synergy_agent_instructions('quickstart') or synergy_agent_instructions('milestones') for complete workflow.

guidance.when_to_use: Multi-platform projects involving 3+ tools, complex workflows, need visual tracking, cross-conversation context, multi-phase projects
guidance.before_calling: Have clear project scope, list of platforms involved, decide flat vs milestone structure, define initial steps or milestones
guidance.after_calling: CRITICAL: Save session_id. For flat structure: call synergy_get_session(), then synergy_update_session() with documents. For milestone structure: update each milestone with synergy_update_milestone()
common_mistakes: Creating resources but forgetting to update session (dashboard shows 0 documents)
Losing session_id and can't update project later
Not fetching existing documents before updating (causes data loss)

Create a new session card in Synergy Dashboard with automatic thread linking. Use for multi-step projects that span conversations. Synergy provides visual Kanban tracking and conversation thread integration. ALWAYS create Synergy session for complex projects (3+ tools, multi-platform). Returns session_id for tracking.

NEW FEATURE: Automatic Thread Linking - When creating a session from within a conversation, the current thread_id is automatically linked to the session. This allows users to see which conversations are related to which projects and vice versa. The thread will show a Synergy card indicator, and the Synergy session will list all linked thread IDs.

Prefer synergy_smart_project_tracker() for most use cases as it provides better defaults and structure.

guidance.when_to_use: Need more control than smart_project_tracker, setting specific fields, advanced use cases
guidance.before_calling: Consider if synergy_smart_project_tracker() would be simpler
guidance.after_calling: Save session_id. Update session after creating each resource.
common_mistakes: Using this instead of simpler synergy_smart_project_tracker()
Not saving session_id for later updates

title.description: Session title (required) - Clear, descriptive name for the project

project_name.description: Project name for grouping related sessions

kanban_column.description: Which Kanban column to place the card (default: backlog)

due_date.description: Due date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ)

assignees.description: List of assignee names or emails

documents.description: List of document links (Google Docs, Sheets, Forms, Drive, etc.). Use 'name' field not 'title'.

thread_ids.description: Link conversation thread IDs to this session (optional - current thread auto-linked). Format: ['thread_abc123', 'thread_def456']. Use this to connect multiple conversations to the same project. The UI will show which threads are related to this Synergy session, and threads will show Synergy indicators. Current thread is automatically added if available in context.

assigned_agents.description: AI agents assigned to work on this session (e.g., ['Research Agent', 'Email Agent'])

sync_google_tasks.description: Whether to sync this session to Google Tasks (default: false). Feature incomplete - not recommended.

sync_google_calendar.description: Whether to sync this session to Google Calendar as an event (default: false). Feature incomplete - not recommended.

uses_milestones.description: Use milestone-based structure instead of flat next_steps checklist (default: false). When true, the session uses milestones/tasks/subtasks for structured multi-phase projects. When false, uses flat next_steps array. CRITICAL: Once set, do NOT mix structures - use milestone functions (synergy_create_milestone, synergy_update_milestone) for milestone sessions, and flat functions (synergy_update_session with next_steps) for flat sessions. For easy milestone setup, prefer synergy_smart_project_tracker() with use_milestones=true and initial_milestones array.

returns.description: Created session object with session_id and all fields

Create a new milestone with tasks and subtasks in one call. Milestones are major phases/stages in a Synergy project that contain multiple tasks. Use milestones when you have a structured project with clear phases like 'Phase 1: Planning', 'Database Setup', 'API Integration', etc. Each milestone can have its own documents, links, tags, priority, due dates, time estimates, and dependencies on other milestones. This is the PRIMARY way to add structured work to a Synergy session.

When to use:
- Project has clear phases or major deliverables
- Need to track progress through structured stages
- Want to organize tasks into logical groups
- Need to set dependencies between phases
- Want milestone-specific documents and links

Workflow:
1. Create session with synergy_smart_project_tracker() or synergy_create_session()
2. Call synergy_create_milestone() for each major phase
3. Save returned milestone_id for future updates
4. As you create resources, update milestone with documents
5. Move to next milestone when complete

Example scenario:
User: 'Create a customer database project'
1. Create session: 'Customer Database System'
2. Create milestone 1: 'Database Setup' with tasks: ['Create Google Sheet', 'Design schema', 'Set up validation']
3. Create milestone 2: 'Data Import' with tasks: ['Export old data', 'Clean data', 'Import to new sheet']
4. Create milestone 3: 'Integration' with tasks: ['Create API', 'Connect to forms', 'Test workflow']

session_id.description: Synergy session ID (required). Get this from synergy_create_session() or synergy_list_sessions(). Format: sess_abc123

milestone_name.description: Milestone title (required). Be clear and descriptive. Examples: 'Database Setup', 'Phase 1: Planning', 'API Integration', 'Customer Onboarding Flow'

description.description: Detailed milestone description (optional). Explain what this phase accomplishes and why it's important. Example: 'Set up customer database with Google Sheets, import existing contacts, and configure automated backups'

tasks.description:
List of tasks for this milestone (optional but recommended). Can be simple strings or objects with subtasks. Each task is a unit of work within the milestone.

Simple format: ['Task 1', 'Task 2', 'Task 3']

Complex format with subtasks:
[
  'Simple task',
  {
    'task': 'Complex task with steps',
    'subtasks': ['Step 1', 'Step 2', 'Step 3']
  }
]

Example:
[
  'Create Google Sheet for customer data',
  {
    'task': 'Import existing contacts',
    'subtasks': [
      'Export from old CRM',
      'Clean and format data',
      'Import to new sheet',
      'Verify data integrity'
    ]
  },
  'Set up automated backups'
]

due_date.description: Due date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD (optional). Example: '2025-12-15'. Use this to set target completion dates.

priority.description: Priority level (optional, default: medium). Use 'critical' for blocking work, 'high' for important phases, 'medium' for normal work, 'low' for nice-to-haves.

estimated_hours.description: Estimated hours to complete milestone (optional). Example: 8.5. Used for time tracking and planning.

documents.description:
Documents specific to this milestone (optional). These are separate from session-level documents. Use for specs, designs, or resources specific to this phase.

Format: [{"title": "Database Schema Design", "url": "https://docs.google.com/document/d/abc123", "type": "google_doc"}]

type.description: Document type: google_doc, google_sheet, google_form, pdf, etc.

links.description:
Related links for this milestone (optional). Examples: dashboards, references, API docs.

Format: [{"title": "API Documentation", "url": "https://api.example.com/docs"}]

start_date.description: Start date in ISO format YYYY-MM-DD (optional). When work on this milestone begins.

depends_on_milestone_id.description: ID of milestone that must complete first (optional). Creates dependency chain. Example: milestone 2 depends on milestone 1 completing.

color_hex.description: Color for visual identification (optional). Hex format like '#FF5733'. Useful for color-coding phases.

returns.description: Created milestone with milestone_id (SAVE THIS!), milestone_number (auto-incremented), tasks_created count, subtasks_created count, and success message. The milestone_id is critical for future updates.

when_to_use: Project has multiple phases or stages
Need to organize tasks into logical groups
Want to track progress through major deliverables
Need to set dependencies between phases
when_not_to_use: Simple project with just a checklist (use next_steps instead)
Already using legacy checklist field (migrate to milestones first)
workflow: Step 1: Create or identify Synergy session
Step 3: Call synergy_create_milestone() for each phase
Step 4: Save returned milestone_id for each
Step 5: As you create resources, call synergy_update_milestone() to add documents
Step 6: Create additional tasks with synergy_create_task() as needed
Step 7: Mark milestones complete when done
best_practices: Use clear, descriptive milestone names (user sees these)
Break complex tasks into subtasks for better tracking
Set realistic due dates and estimates
Use priority to highlight blocking/critical phases
Add milestone-specific documents rather than all at session level
Link dependent milestones to enforce ordering
ALWAYS save the returned milestone_id - you'll need it for updates
error_handling: Error 'session_id required' → Pass valid session_id from synergy_create_session()
Error 'Session not found' → Session doesn't exist, list sessions to find correct ID
Error 'milestone_name required' → Must provide a title for the milestone
Network timeout → Retry the request, milestone wasn't created

synergy_update_milestone - Update milestone fields, add documents/links
synergy_create_task - Add tasks to existing milestone
synergy_create_subtask - Add subtasks to existing task
